text:
I was not very impressed at all with this clinic. I booked an appointment for my cat for a week for her to be spayed. They assured me that I would get a reminder call. The night before the appointment I realized I did not get a call and started to be concerned if the appointment was the next day or not. I called the clinic at 8:40pm to follow up. They apologized for not calling and that the appointment was indeed the next day. Right as I was about to hang up they said to make sure not to feed my cat past 9pm that night. Which irritated me because if I did not call in I would not have known, and to me I feel it would be detrimental to insure something like that. I brought my cat in, paid for everything.  So I thought. When I picked her up they stated they forgot to put the exam cost on. I was extremely upset that so much miscommunication and negligence occurred in the course of 24 hours. Also, my cat was covered in her own waste for being so frightened and they did not even bath her afterwards which I had to do carefully when I go home. I have brought other cats into different vet clinics but never have a seen a cat so traumatized. When I brought her home her eye seems swollen, she would cower anytime I tried to comfort her. I do not feel like she was treated well at all. I would never go back or ever recommend this place to anyone.
- Kaitlyn

We have been regulars to this vet since it opened due to its proximity to where we lived. Recently we have moved quite far but currently are still making the drive while we look for something closer. 

Dr. Jun Yang is a very nice man who seems to care about my animals. There is a language barrier that I occasionally have felt frustrated by as I have to ask him to repeat himself frequently and sometimes I have difficulty understanding what is going on with my pets. That said, he doesn't seem to mind repeating himself. We do have to frequently wait for long periods in the exam room while he finishes with other patients (despite having booked appointments) which can be annoying. There have been times when we waited up to a half hour in a very warm and stuffy little room (or so it begins to feel). 

I am saddened to hear people worry he doesn't care about the animals, I remember when we came in for an appointment after my pup had her spay surgery the doctor told us to wait a moment and returned with his phone. On it he had taken a picture of our pup Lola after she woke from surgery. She was holding herself halfway up on the sides of her ankles, feet all akimbo. I thought it was really sweet he obviously thought she was adorable (as do we) and wanted to show us. 

The desk staff here and assistants are very sweet and knowledgeable. They always make a great impression and have never been rude on the phone or otherwise. We have had to order fortiflora from them on several occasions and it's always there when they say it will be, and they call to let us know when  it comes in. They are very prompt and on top of things when it comes to reminders. 

The facilities themselves are clean and fairly new, and feel welcoming.

Terrible place. Dr. Yang is the worst vet I've ever been to. He is very cold, and unwelcoming. After paying $130 for an "exam", he barely even looked and our dog, and wanted to sedate her! He is only concerned about the money. He will try to charge extra services that are unneeded. Please do NOT go here! Terrible experience!

Avoid! After having an emergency situation with my dog I rushed him to the nearest clinic. When I arrived the first question that was asked was " do I want to make them my regular vet?" Umm excuse me? I haven't even had the appointment yet. The vet was nice and thorough, however the language barrier made it difficult to understand. Without doing blood work, one test was done and it was assumed he has pancreatitis. After staying over night with IV's, antibiotics and a $1000 vet bill, they released him the next day without take home antibiotics or a plan of action. He did not get better in the least, after taking him to my regular vet she diagnosed a kidney infection. So now I question if he even had pancreatitis in the first place or if it was a misdiagnosed kidney infection. The front of house staff is very good however, I felt as if all the testing and atmosphere of the clinic is to make money, not about client satisfaction.

I had a terrible experience here at this Clinic. Along with my Dog (shih Tzu). We took him in when we noticed that he was not eating or drinking and his poop did not look right. The vet kept him there overnight to run tests. The next day I go by and visit to find my dog locked in a storage closet because he was barking too much. He does not bark at all. Unfortunately at just a young age of only 4 years I had to put him down because he had kidney failure. It was a horrible experience because right after they had euthanized my poor dog they wanted me to pay a cost for using the room even though I paid a large amount in vet bills and getting him cremated. Animal owners beware.

Terrible place !!! Terrible vets !! Will take the extra time to drive to downtown when in need of an emergency vet or stick with Dr Lee Castledowns Animal Hospital ! They over drugged my cat not to mention put him through extreme pain for 35-40 minutes over an X-ray ........ Friend took a choking dog there tonight they had a crappy experience too and left paying 150 for no treatment

Got totally ripped off at this clinic. I brought my cat in about 5 times before this happened. I specifically booked an appointment for my cat for one exam. Not more than one. My bill shouldn't have cost more then $200, but the vet did 3 other exams, none of which I asked for, after I dropped my cat off. This ended up costing me almost $600. 

The first time I went there, a guy came to pick up his dog and was yelling about the bill. He claimed they were only supposed to remove one dewclaw, but I dismissed this as him trying to just pay less. They don't give your pet back unless you pay, and the vet's accent is so horrendous, I think he uses the language barrier as a way to make people think it was just a lack of communication that caused a misunderstanding. 

I don't recommend this clinic to anybody.

Wish I had read the reviews before I went to this clinic. My dog had been vomitting for 2 days and on the second day (a holiday) wanted to get him checked out. Now according to advertisements regular hours are 9-5 on sat, sun and holidays. When I called was advised that there would be a $100 emergency call out fee before my dog would even be looked at. No problem, my dog was sick and I wanted him assessed (even though we were seeing during advertised regular hours). (Our regular vet is Terwilligar but we live in Clareview which is why I chose Hollick over Guardian). NEVER take your animal to dr. Asian whatever his name is! 

Kept trying to get me to do all these expensive tests (which couldn't be done on location anyway and would have to wait for a weekday for a diagnosis) which if I'm going to get done would be through my own vet! Wouldn't do anything for my dog without doing the most expensive tests first!

There was a big note on front desk that emergency payment must be made prior to dr. Seeing your animal. I can see where that came from as I'm sure people have walked out on this idiot!

The worst part is my dog now has to suffer until tomorrow when I can get him to Terwillegar where I know he will be treated immediately and with compassion. 

The dr. Said something to the effect that he couldn't do anything without these expensive tests because if it was something he didn't test for he didn't want to get sued. Gives me the impression he's already being sued. It wouldn't surprise me one bit!

TAKE YOUR ANIMAL ANYWHERE BUT HERE!!
